description: This Java class implements a SOAP event handler for processing SOAP requests and WSDL retrieval in a web application, including service invocation, WSDL generation, and error handling.

classes.name: SOAPEventHandler
classes.description: Implements a SOAP event handler for processing SOAP requests, generating WSDL, and invoking services.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with the servlet context.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Handles incoming SOAP requests, processes WSDL requests, invokes services, and returns responses.

methods.name: validateSOAPBody
methods.description: Validates that the SOAP body contains exactly one service call request.

methods.name: createAndSendSOAPResponse
methods.description: Creates a SOAP response message with service results and sends it to the client.

methods.name: sendError
methods.description: Sends an error message as a SOAP response.

methods.name: getLocationURI
methods.description: Constructs the request's location URI based on the HttpServletRequest.
